# homeassistant_schedule (Resource)

A schedule helper (`schedule`): weekly time ranges in which the schedule is on, e.g. a tariff window. Its state is `on` inside a range and `off` outside.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A cheap-tariff window: on weekdays from 22:00 to midnight and from midnight to 06:00, all
# day on weekends. The entity is schedule.cheap_tariff, and it is "on" inside a range.
resource "homeassistant_schedule" "cheap_tariff" {
  name = "Cheap Tariff"
  icon = "mdi:cash-clock"

  monday    = [{ from = "00:00:00", to = "06:00:00" }, { from = "22:00:00", to = "24:00:00" }]
  tuesday   = [{ from = "00:00:00", to = "06:00:00" }, { from = "22:00:00", to = "24:00:00" }]
  wednesday = [{ from = "00:00:00", to = "06:00:00" }, { from = "22:00:00", to = "24:00:00" }]
  thursday  = [{ from = "00:00:00", to = "06:00:00" }, { from = "22:00:00", to = "24:00:00" }]
  friday    = [{ from = "00:00:00", to = "06:00:00" }, { from = "22:00:00", to = "24:00:00" }]
  saturday  = [{ from = "00:00:00", to = "24:00:00" }]
  sunday    = [{ from = "00:00:00", to = "24:00:00" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the helper in place.

### Optional

- `friday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Friday, in order of `from`. The ranges must not overlap. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--friday))
- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:toggle-switch`.
- `id` (String) Helper ID, a slug such as `guest_mode`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the helper is created, and keeps it when the helper is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the helper. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.
- `monday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Monday, in order of `from`. The ranges must not overlap. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monday))
- `saturday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Saturday, in order of `from`. The ranges must not overlap. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saturday))
- `sunday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Sunday, in order of `from`. The ranges must not overlap. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sunday))
- `thursday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Thursday, in order of `from`. The ranges must not overlap. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--thursday))
- `tuesday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Tuesday, in order of `from`. The ranges must not overlap. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tuesday))
- `wednesday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Wednesday, in order of `from`. The ranges must not overlap. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wednesday))

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the helper, `schedule.<id>`.

<a id="nestedatt--friday"></a>
### Nested Schema for `friday`

Required:

- `from` (String) Start of the range, as `HH:MM:SS` (24 hours), e.g. `07:00:00`. The schedule is on from here.
- `to` (String) End of the range, as `HH:MM:SS` (24 hours), later than `from`, e.g. `22:00:00`. Use `24:00:00` for the end of the day. The schedule is off from here.

Optional:

- `data` (String) Custom values of the range, as JSON text, e.g. `jsonencode({ price = 0.12, peak = true })`. It must be an object whose values are strings, numbers or booleans. Home Assistant shows them as attributes of the entity while the range is active. Unset, the range has none. The order of keys and the spelling of numbers do not matter.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a schedule helper by its ID.
tofu import homeassistant_schedule.cheap_tariff cheap_tariff
```
